title: Hello, Anna!
text:
Tom: Hi, Anna. How are you? Anna: I am fine, thanks. And you? Tom: I am good, thank you.

Anna: Where is the bus? Tom: It is near the park. Anna: Thank you, Tom! Tom: You are welcome.

questions.text: How does Anna feel at the end?
What kind of people are Tom and Anna?

vocabulary.definition: a place with grass and trees where people walk and play
a large vehicle that carries many people
a polite answer when someone says thank you

paragraph_translations: Tom: Cześć, Anna. Jak się masz? Anna: Dobrze, dzięki. A ty? Tom: Ja też dobrze, dziękuję.
Anna: Gdzie jest autobus? Tom: Jest blisko parku. Anna: Dziękuję, Tom! Tom: Proszę bardzo.
